title: DNA OS ↔ DigitalOcean Provider Connection
scope: Existing DigitalOcean provider definitions and the five read-only DNA OS connector intents. No deployment, hosting, write capability, credential registry, Vault client, or new connector is introduced by this document.

security.rule: Secret values are never recorded. Only credential reference shapes, provider auth method names, and resolution mechanisms are recorded.

references.name: vault://digitalocean/<team>/<credential>
references.purpose: Reference shape accepted by the DigitalOcean credential provider
references.resolution: A future Vault-backed CredentialProvider; no production Vault client exists

references.name: DigitalOcean PAT / OAuth2 / Spaces key / inference bearer auth
references.resolution: Provider account binding and credential broker; no production binding or broker exists

boundaries.authentication: Provider definitions describe PAT, OAuth2, Spaces key, and inference bearer auth; no credential is resolved here
boundaries.authority_permission: The action catalog defines the endpoint, HTTP method, and required scope used by the adapter; it does not grant runtime authority
boundaries.input_schema: DigitalOcean provider identity and action definitions
boundaries.output_result: Provider action record consumed by provider-action-lookup
boundaries.state_transition: provider definition → resolved action contract or undefined

boundaries.destination: Owner command router and Capability Registry
boundaries.authentication: The router receives the already-formed Owner command; DigitalOcean binding and scope gates are downstream
boundaries.authority_permission: Capability Registry declares DigitalOcean as CONNECTED with five supported read intents; connector authorization remains responsible for provider authority
boundaries.input_schema: CommandEnvelope with one of the five digitalocean.* intents and {digitalocean_team_id, auth_method}
boundaries.output_result: RoutingResult reaching the registered connector boundary, or a typed BLOCKED result
boundaries.state_transition: classified → capability selected → connector boundary invoked, or fail closed
live_evidence_reference: control/command-router/tests/digitalocean-connector-routing.test.ts: capability registry, classification, real connector reachability, BLOCKED AUTH_REQUIRED result

boundaries.authentication: Provider-specific dependencies are closed over by router-invoker at module load; the router does not receive raw credentials
boundaries.authority_permission: Generic boundary translates authenticate-stage rejection to auth_required=true; it never fabricates success
boundaries.state_transition: invoker registry lookup → provider invoker → uniform connector outcome
live_evidence_reference: control/command-router/tests/digitalocean-connector-routing.test.ts: route reaches real connector and returns BLOCKED/AUTH_REQUIRED

boundaries.transport_or_signal: In-process adapter call with closed production providers
boundaries.authentication: Binding and credential providers are injected only inside the provider invoker
boundaries.authority_permission: Only the five declared read intents are accepted; create/update/delete and undeclared intents are rejected at classify
boundaries.output_result: DigitalOceanAdapterOutcome: normalized EventEnvelope + evidence, or typed rejection + evidence
boundaries.state_transition: classify → resolve binding → status gate → scope gate → credential resolve → API call → normalize → evidence
live_evidence_reference: connections/digitalocean/tests/adapter.test.ts: fail-closed and five read capability paths

boundaries.authentication: Would resolve a reference-only AccountCredentialBinding; no registry or persistence exists
boundaries.authority_permission: A real binding would identify the DNA OS account, DigitalOcean team, auth method, scopes, expiry, verification, and revocation state
boundaries.state_transition: lookup → binding or undefined; production implementation currently always returns undefined
live_evidence_reference: control/command-router/tests/digitalocean-connector-routing.test.ts: production path returns AUTH_REQUIRED before network

boundaries.authentication: No credential is resolved before both gates pass
boundaries.authority_permission: Expired, revoked, and unverified bindings are denied; required scope is checked, with api:read fallback for provider actions marked not_confirmed
boundaries.input_schema: AccountCredentialBinding + required scope from provider action record

boundaries.transport_or_signal: In-process credential-provider contract; intended Vault lookup
boundaries.authentication: Only a vault:// reference is allowed; no raw secret is documented or persisted
boundaries.authority_permission: Credential resolution occurs only after binding status and scope gates; production provider explicitly returns VAULT_NOT_YET_BUILT
boundaries.output_result: CredentialResolution {ok, secret, credential_source} or failure reason; production path always fails
live_evidence_reference: control/command-router/tests/digitalocean-connector-routing.test.ts: no binding means credential provider is not reached

boundaries.transport_or_signal: HTTPS GET with Authorization: Bearer reference-resolved token; 15-second timeout
boundaries.authentication: Bearer token would be supplied by CredentialProvider; no real credential exists in the repository/environment
boundaries.authority_permission: Provider action scope and binding gates precede the network call; API non-2xx and transport failures are returned, never swallowed
boundaries.input_schema: Resolved endpoint from provider action record plus bearer credential
boundaries.output_result: DigitalOceanApiOutcome with HTTP status/body or typed transport/API failure
boundaries.state_transition: authorized credential → GET request → response/error → normalized capability result
live_evidence_reference: dna-os-circuit/definition/circuit.json#DO_API_CALL: real network round trip to /v2/account returned HTTP 404 and was reported as failure

boundaries.transport_or_signal: In-process typed event/rejection and safe evidence trail
boundaries.authentication: Credential values are excluded; only safe credential_source references and HTTP outcome metadata may appear
boundaries.authority_permission: A rejected API call remains an auditable failure; normalized output never passes raw upstream JSON through
boundaries.output_result: Normalized account/regions/sizes/droplets/billing result, or typed rejection with evidence
boundaries.state_transition: API response/error → normalized result or BLOCKED rejection → router outcome
live_evidence_reference: dna-os-circuit/definition/circuit.json#DO_RESULT_EVIDENCE: real CapabilityResultEvidence trail and typed rejection for HTTP 404
connections/digitalocean/tests/adapter.test.ts: normalized five read results and no-secret assertions

boundaries.contract_function: No production deployment connector or resource binding exists in this repository
boundaries.authentication: No deployment credential reference or target resource identifier is recorded
boundaries.authority_permission: Provider definitions describe possible resources, but no DNA OS authority path is wired for deployment or mutation
boundaries.state_transition: No deployment request path → no DigitalOcean hosting state transition
live_evidence_reference: No DigitalOcean deployment/resource evidence is claimed; provider catalog presence is not deployment evidence

data_flow.command_path: Owner command → command router → Capability Registry → connector execution boundary → DigitalOcean invoker → read adapter
data_flow.authorization_path: Adapter classifies the intent, resolves the account binding, rejects expired/revoked/unverified bindings, checks required scope, then attempts credential resolution
data_flow.api_path: Only after the gates and credential resolution succeed would the GET-only host runtime call DigitalOcean Core v2 and normalize the response
data_flow.failure_path: The current production path resolves no account binding, returns AUTH_REQUIRED/BLOCKED, and performs no authenticated API call
data_flow.deployment_path: No DigitalOcean hosting/deployment path is wired; resource definitions are catalog data only

authority.provider_contract: providers/digitalocean/definition files define supported resources, endpoints, methods, and scopes
authority.command_authority: Capability Registry and connector execution boundary determine whether a DigitalOcean command can reach the adapter
authority.account_authority: A future AccountBindingProvider would bind a DNA OS account to a DigitalOcean team and credential reference; no registry exists
authority.credential_authority: A future Vault-backed CredentialProvider would resolve the reference; production implementation currently fails closed
authority.api_authority: DigitalOcean bearer credential plus provider scope; no authenticated credential is currently available
authority.deployment_authority: No deployment authority or target binding is present

overall_gaps: No production DigitalOcean account-binding registry or persistence exists.
No production Vault/credential broker exists for DigitalOcean references.
The real API path has only unauthenticated/failed live evidence; no authenticated success is recorded.
No DigitalOcean deployment or hosting resource is bound to DNA OS.
The provider catalog contains resources beyond the five read-only adapter intents, but those capabilities are not wired into this connector.
next_required_connection: If separately authorized, establish the existing account-binding and credential-broker boundaries before attempting authenticated verification. Do not infer deployment connectivity from provider definitions.

verified_boundaries: command router and Capability Registry reach connector
blocked: authenticated DigitalOcean API call: real endpoint reached but no authenticated credential exists; live call evidence is HTTP 404/unauthenticated probe HTTP 403

projections.machine_view: This JSON document: resources, boundaries, contracts, authority, data flow, evidence, and per-boundary status.
projections.developer_view: Source references and failure gates are recorded in each boundary.
